populationMethod: 2020 Census tract population allocated by ZCTA-tract land area, summed to the county. Connecticut planning regions use 2020 town population allocated by ZCTA-town land area. A ZIP whose population total is missing or zero is ranked by land area.
license: Public domain (U.S. government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105). Cite the U.S. Census Bureau.
weightDefinition: p is a share of estimated 2020 population. l is a share of land area (AREALAND_PART / ZCTA land). Counties are ranked by that share, then by county FIPS.
